overview_description.description: Future Fields is committed to producing sustainable components for science through insect biotechnology. Its EntoEngine™ platform is the first to harness the genetic prowess of fruit flies to produce Earth’s most environmentally and economically sustainable biomolecules. Founded in 2018, Future Fields is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada and proudly backed by marquee venture capital firms and investors from Silicon Valley and beyond. Learn more about how Future Fields is enabling great science at https://futurefields.io/.

product.name: EntoEngine™

product.description: A glycosylated recombinant human prolactin protein produced using fruit flies, intended for research in lactation, cultivated milk, and cell biology.

product.description: A platelet-derived growth factor BB protein produced in fruit flies for research in cell growth, angiogenesis, and tissue regeneration.

product.description: Tailored recombinant protein production services using the EntoEngine™ platform to express challenging protein targets.
